name: FrenchModelVariant153_HandleRequest

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-136/266 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant153_entry_usa.c (VARIANT153_PRINT_WORK_SIZE adds the work-size printf), with the US images binding gFrenchModelVariant153_D0E0C 0xC higher; gFrenchModelVariant153_D0E1C, gFrenchModelVariant153_D0F18 0x1C higher than the French images (notes/overlays/usa-model-french-entries.md).
